mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM space s WHERE s.group_id = #{groupId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.assignee_id, u.name AS assignee_name, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_deletion_request r WHERE r.space_id = s.id AND r.status = 'PENDING' AND r.expires_at > #{now}) AS deletion_pending FROM space s LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.assignee_id WHERE s.group_id = #{groupId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.id, c.type, c.from_user_id, CASE WHEN f.deleted_at IS NULL THEN f.name ELSE #{withdrawnName} END AS from_user_name, c.to_user_id, CASE WHEN t.deleted_at IS NULL THEN t.name ELSE #{withdrawnName} END AS to_user_name, c.actor_id, CASE WHEN a.deleted_at IS NULL THEN a.name ELSE #{withdrawnName} END AS actor_name, c.reason, c.occurred_at FROM assignment_change c LEFT JOIN users f ON f.id = c.from_user_id LEFT JOIN users t ON t.id = c.to_user_id JOIN users a ON a.id = c.actor_id WHERE c.space_id = #{spaceId} ORDER BY c.occurred_at, c.id
